name: Write a training course
description: Research a subject, write the course content, then generate self-contained HTML slides in the session's tree.

nodes.name: Research
nodes.prompt:
{{task}}

Research the subject in the project (code, docs) and on the web (web_search; cite each source with its URL or file path). Ask the human (ask_user) when the audience, level, duration or format is unclear. Then propose: audience and prerequisites, learning objectives (what a learner can do afterwards), the modules with their key points, exercises and their solutions, the number of slides per module, the output folder (default `training/<slug>/`: `content.md` for the trainer's material and exercises, `slides.html` for the deck), and the sources. End with a "Done when" list as the plan's contract: checkable criteria end with `— check: \`<command>\``, e.g. `test -s training/<slug>/slides.html`. End with the complete plan.

nodes.name: Content
nodes.prompt: Write the course content of the approved outline above: per module the explanations, examples, exercises and solutions, sources cited inline; no fact absent from the research's sources or the project. End with the report.

nodes.name: Slides
nodes.prompt: Generate the deck from the content just written: one self-contained HTML file (inline CSS and JS, no network, no external fonts or CDN), one `<section>` per slide, keyboard navigation (arrows, space, Home/End) and a slide counter, readable at 1280×720 and when printed (one slide per page), a title slide, one slide per key point (short bullets, code in `<pre><code>`), speaker notes in `<aside class"notes">` hidden on screen, a closing slide with the sources. The slides follow the content: they add nothing the content does not say. End with the report.
nodes.retryPrompt: Update the slides to the revised content above, then end with the report.

nodes.name: Verify
Remaining problems
